{{Infobox/Helmet Skin |rarity = ultimate |id = GLACIAL_DIVAN }} The '''Glacial Divan Helmet Skin''' is an {{Ultimate}} [[Helmet Skin]] that could be purchased from the Hypixel Store. == Obtaining == {{Cosmetic Miscellaneous Source|The '''Glacial Divan Helmet Skin''' could be purchased from the Hypixel Store during a 2025 Holiday promotion.|2025 Hypixel Store Holiday Promotion}} == Usage == {{Helmet Skin Usage|applied = Helmet of Divan|selectable_versions = 20|animated = yes|notes = {{Green|Features!}}
{{Dark Gray|▶}} This skin is swappable between {{Green|20}} glacial variants.
{{Dark Gray|▶}} Keeps track of every [[Pristine|{{Dark Purple|Pristine Proc}}]] obtained wearing this skin.
{{Dark Gray|▶}} Displays a {{Gold|special particle effect}} when you have [[Cold|{{Aqua|Cold}}]].}} == Interface == {{/UI}} == Gallery == {{Cosmetic Gallery |file1 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Rose).gif |name1 = Rose |file2 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Red).gif |name2 = Red |file3 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Orange).gif |name3 = Orange |file4 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Gold).gif |name4 = Gold |file5 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Yellow).gif |name5 = Yellow |file6 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Lime).gif |name6 = Lime |file7 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Green).gif |name7 = Green |file8 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Purple).gif |name8 = Purple |file9 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Portal).gif |name9 = Portal |file10 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Aurora).gif |name10 = Aurora |file11 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Azure).gif |name11 = Azure |file12 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Blue).gif |name12 = Blue |file13 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Oasis).gif |name13 = Oasis |file14 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Snowflake).gif |name14 = Snowflake |file15 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Sunset).gif |name15 = Sunset |file16 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Pastel).gif |name16 = Pastel |file17 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Pink).gif |name17 = Pink |file18 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Teal).gif |name18 = Teal |file19 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Black Ice).gif |name19 = Black Ice |file20 = Glacial Divan Helmet Skin (Black).gif |name20 = Black }} == Game Messages == {|class="wikitable" !
